design.corpus: cells/U4/u4_sessions.json (generated by u4_corpus.py; corpora/compaction.json does not exist)
design.reps_rationale: a second repetition re-sends byte-identical post-compaction prompts the server already cached, so it would report ~0 and measure memoisation instead of the break
design.volatile: {} on every turn (baked snapshot never re-rendered)

grid_baseline.note: On a warm appended turn uncached == prompt_tokens % 64, so this residual should be 0. A nonzero value means the 64-grid assumption behind break_cost does not hold for that row.

kill_condition.condition: break_cost for edit policies statistically indistinguishable from fork across >=4 events

structural.note: message 0 is the salted invariant head (per-cell salt), so only messages[1:] are comparable across cells; the salt is what keeps cells in separate radix paths.
